chat.busyOther: An answer is still being written in another conversation. Wait for it or stop it to send here.
chat.deleteConfirm: Delete the conversation "{{title}}" from the history? The log of what was sent to Claude keeps its records.
chat.empty: Ask about your library. Select documents in the list, or open one in the reader, to give them as context.
chat.contextLimit: At most {{limit}} documents can be given as context: only the first {{limit}} of {{count}} will be used.
chat.shortcuts: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Ctrl+J shows or hides the chat, Ctrl+K opens the commands.
